search.query: | mstats avg("nvidia.temperature_gpu_temp") as Temp avg("nvidia.utilization_gpu_util") as "GPU Util %" avg("nvidia.fb_memory_usage_used") as "Mem Used" avg("nvidia.fb_memory_usage_total") as "Mem Total" avg("nvidia.gpu_power_readings_average_power_draw") as "Power (W)" avg("nvidia.fan_speed") as "Fan %" avg("nvidia.clocks_graphics_clock") as "Graphics Clock" where index=metrics by gpu_name span=1m | rename gpu_name as GPU, gpu_uuid as UUID
| mstats avg("nvidia.utilization_gpu_util") as "GPU Util %" where index=metrics by gpu_name span=1m | xyseries _time gpu_name "GPU Util %"
| mstats avg("nvidia.fb_memory_usage_used") as "Mem Used" where index=metrics by gpu_name span=1m | xyseries _time gpu_name "Mem Used"
| mstats avg("nvidia.temperature_gpu_temp") as Temp avg("nvidia.gpu_power_readings_average_power_draw") as Power where index=metrics span=1m
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics | eval count=mvcount(m)
